page.layout: One page of text in a single column, indented from the left edge. Page number and running head at the top. Italic subtitle under the running head, then running text with an italic label and a worked sum, ending in a catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Est numeratio, qua numerus subducitur à numero, & habetur Reliquus.

Vulgus subtrahit à dextra versus sinistrā: At nonnulli à sinistra versus dextram subtrahere solent: quem ordinem nos seruabimus. Numerus major primum scribat: de-inde numerus minor directè subnotetur.
Postea primam inferioris subtrahito à prima superioris, & quod remanserit directè supra ponito, quod si nihil relictum fuerit, præcedente aliqua nota, scribito o.
Porrò si nota inferior superiorem exces-serit, huic præponito unum supra mente reservatum, aut unum à præcedente supra posito numero detractum : atq; tum dedu-cito inferiorem.
Debeo tibi 7454, septies millenos quadringentos quinquaginta quatuor Thaleros : Et solvi 6545, sexies millenos quingentos quadraginta quinq;.
Et dico 6 à 7 remanet unum, quod se-quenti subtrahendæ notæ, à qua inferior

page.notes: Page is clean. The two-line sum is printed with the 6 of the subtrahend set high; it is copied here at the same level. The catchword "sub-" is printed at the lower right. The stain and spine shadow are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "scribat" (line end, final letters unclear), "relictum" (ligature ct), "subtrahit" (partly worn).
